Most of the severe weather in New York State is from Interstate 90 to Albany southward. We have seen severe thunderstorms in the mix. Other thunderstorms are developing in New Jersey and Pennsylvania so there will be more showers, thunderstorms and severe weather this afternoon into tonight.
